question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**The".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We can use '**the history' **when talking about the history of something or somewhere.
 
• **History** generally is an uncountable noun, but it becomes specific, and countable when talking about the history of something or somewhere.
 
• The history is correct. Because here **"the history" **means all the histories till now.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

The complete passage is- *Nawab Mir Osman Ali Khan was the last ruler of Hyderabad, the largest princely state in British India. He ascended the throne (1) at the age of 25 and ruled Hyderabad for 37 years. He (2) was featured on the cover of Time magazine as the (3) richest person at the time. He was the 5th richest man in (4) the** history of mankind and the richest Indian who ever lived. He was a (5)benevolent ruler who encouraged education, science, and development.*
